name: Thousand Arrows
description:
You summon forth a volley of green arrows to pierce creatures in range. Each creature in a {shape} centered on a point within range makes a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Any creature that fails the saving throw falls to the ground and becomes grounded, losing its ground-type immunity if it had it, until it moves.

Damage dealt by this move ignores immunity to ground-type damage. If the target's non-Flying type(s) gives it vulnerability or resistance to this attack, it follows that type.
